en: Added support for `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` and `forceLoginGatewayUrl` in your own user settings on machines with no managed settings, so `/login` opens on that Claude apps gateway
zh: 在没有托管设置的机器上，自己的用户设置新增 `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` 和 `forceLoginGatewayUrl` 支持，使 `/login` 在该 Claude 应用网关上打开
